_note: Workload matrix. The loss is NOT visible at a small decode batch -- it needs every request in flight at once -- and it needs a long generation to keep the run in decode rather than prefill; upstream's own shape (in 2 / out 1000, all 8,196 requests at once) is the anchor. The two other scored points keep the batch large (2,048 and 4,096 in flight) so a repair is measured across the regime rather than at one point; c=64 is the guard: a large-batch repair must not tax the small-batch decode path. Same server settings for every point.
